results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (for context/verification)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch repository metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY (confirm access, default_branch).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: List all repository branches using GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES (capture names + protected flag for targeting).
[Required] [Step]: For protected/critical branches, inspect rules using GITHUB_GET_BRANCH_PROTECTION (determine if PR reviews are required before merging/pushing).
[Optional (if a branch name is ambiguous or missing)] [Fallback]: Confirm branch exists and collect metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_BRANCH (resolve renames/deletions).
[Required] [Step]: List repository collaborators using GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_COLLABORATORS (collect permission flags/roles to infer who can push).
[Optional (if a specific user’s rights are unclear)] [Next Step]: Resolve per-user access using GITHUB_GET_REPOSITORY_PERMISSIONS_FOR_A_USER (disambiguate direct push eligibility).
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES] Pagination via page/per_page—iterate until an empty page to avoid missing branches in large repos.
[GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_COLLABORATORS] Pagination via page/per_page—don’t assume a single page contains all developers.
[GITHUB_GET_BRANCH_PROTECTION] Returns 404 for unprotected branches—treat as no protection rules (potential direct commits) while handling errors gracefully.
[GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_COLLABORATORS] Determine push ability from permissions.push or role_name (not display labels) to avoid misclassification.
[GITHUB_GET_REPOSITORY_PERMISSIONS_FOR_A_USER] May be inconclusive for non-collaborators or org-level access—report as unknown rather than false/true.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: GitHub is a code hosting platform for version control and collaboration, offering Git-based repository management, issue tracking, and continuous integration features
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=github. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="github") to create a connection BEFORE executing any github tools.

GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES.description: List branches in a GitHub repository. Returns branch names, commit information, and protection status. Use this action when you need to retrieve all branches in a repository, optionally filtered by protection status. This is useful for identifying available branches, checking which branches are protected, or preparing to create pull requests.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see 'Using pagination in the REST API'.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see 'Using pagination in the REST API'.

protected.description: Setting to `true` returns only branches protected by branch protections or rulesets. When set to `false`, only unprotected branches are returned. Omitting this parameter returns all branches.

GITHUB_GET_BRANCH_PROTECTION.description: Retrieves branch protection settings for a specific, existing, and accessible branch in a GitHub repository; protection feature availability varies by GitHub product plan.

repo.description: Name of the repository, without the `.git` extension; not case-sensitive.

owner.description: Account owner of the repository (username or organization name); not case-sensitive.

branch.description: Name of the branch; wildcard characters are not supported (use GitHub GraphQL API for wildcard matching).

GITHUB_LIST_REPOSITORY_COLLABORATORS.description: Lists collaborators for a specified repository, provided it exists and is accessible to the authenticated user.

page.description: The page number of the results to retrieve.

repo.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This value is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The username of the account that owns the repository. This value is not case sensitive.

per_page.description: The number of results to return per page. Maximum value is 100.

permission.description: Filter collaborators by their repository permission level. If not specified, all collaborators are returned regardless of permission.

affiliation.description: Filter collaborators by affiliation: 'outside' (collaborators of an organization-owned repository not part of the org), 'direct' (collaborators with direct permissions to an organization-owned repository), or 'all' (all collaborators visible to the authenticated user).

GITHUB_GET_A_BRANCH.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specified branch within a GitHub repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

branch.description: The name of the branch. Cannot contain wildcard characters. To use wildcard characters in branch names, use [the GraphQL API](https://docs.github.com/graphql). If 'HEAD' is provided, it will be resolved to the repository's default branch.

GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY.description: Retrieves detailed information about an existing and accessible GitHub repository.

GITHUB_GET_REPOSITORY_PERMISSIONS_FOR_A_.description: Retrieves a specific user's permission level ('admin', 'write', 'read', or 'none') for a given repos...
